scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp raishelmycv.html dist/cv.html && cp coverletter.html dist/ && cp broucherpolitic.html dist/ && cp proposal-khairul-aming.html dist/ && cp ma63_dashboard_mobile.html dist/ma63.html && cp prn_sabah_2025_warisan_analysis.html dist/ && cp pru2027_government_formation_simulation.html dist/ && cp prn2025result.json dist/ && cp pru2022_parlimen_except_sabah.json dist/ && cp robots.txt dist/ && cp sitemap.xml dist/ && cp *.png dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp *.jpg dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp *.ico dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp *.webp dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r data dist/ && cp -r tips_slide dist/ && mkdir -p dist/tips && cp tips_slide/index.html dist/tips/index.html && for f in tips_slide/*.html; do name=$(basename "$f"); [ "$name" != "index.html" ] && slug="${name%.html}" && mkdir -p "dist/tips/$slug" && cp "$f" "dist/tips/$slug/index.html"; done && mkdir -p dist/blog && cp -r public/blog/. dist/blog/ && cp -r public/uploads dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && printf '/blog/* /blog/post.html 200\n/api/profile /data/profile.json 200\n' > dist/_redirects
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch production
